objective: Advance CFBE-Ω by composing existing Federation capability rather than duplicating benchmark, execution, assurance or recovery systems.

capabilities.cfbe_role: capability genomes, causal attribution, evidence economics, shadow tournaments, recovery/value qualification
capabilities.boundary: CFBE remains benchmark/value governor; FC-OS does not inherit execution authority

capabilities.cfbe_role: competing hypotheses, falsification, causal reasoning, frontier mechanism decomposition
capabilities.boundary: scientific proposal and reasoning do not self-certify benchmark promotion

capabilities.cfbe_role: risk-adaptive proof selection, omission proof, content-addressed proof, selector falsification
capabilities.boundary: proof selection never grants provider authority or external effects

capabilities.cfbe_role: mission closure contract, dependency DAG, proof vector, source convergence, durable failure resolver
capabilities.boundary: MCE coordinates closure; CFBE independently evaluates proof-adjusted maturity and value

capabilities.cfbe_role: durable mission ledger, idempotency, replay, checkpoints, lane isolation, fan-in telemetry
capabilities.boundary: execution state is evidence input, not benchmark authority

capabilities.cfbe_role: freshness, revision, health, drift, regression and stall signals
capabilities.boundary: Sentinel remains an independent observer rather than a CFBE submodule

capabilities.cfbe_role: real failure, recovery, recurrence and owner-correction evidence
capabilities.boundary: synthetic behavior cannot promote empirical failure intelligence

capabilities.cfbe_role: truth/solution separation, lifecycle claims, fault-book, reuse-before-build, false-completion prevention
capabilities.boundary: source or invocation proof cannot become host-bound or operational proof
CFBE may consume JARVIS verdicts but must not subsume its independence

capabilities.cfbe_role: provider identity, route, exact-effect authority, execution, readback and rollback
capabilities.boundary: CFBE evaluates; SOVARA executes within current authority

capabilities.cfbe_role: durable canonical capability, mission, benchmark, learning and provenance projections
capabilities.boundary: derived projections do not outrank provider/source evidence

capabilities.cfbe_role: materially different routes, bounded parallel waves and challenger formation
capabilities.boundary: route formation is not effect authorization

capabilities.cfbe_role: opaque mission-scoped capability references for bounded experiments
capabilities.boundary: raw secrets remain excluded from CFBE state and public source

capabilities.cfbe_role: retry, DLQ, trace, replay and distributed route transport
capabilities.boundary: mesh controls do not imply provider-live runtime maturity

capabilities.cfbe_role: design lineage, decision provenance and receiver-local Design Gene learning
capabilities.boundary: design lineage is evidence context, not live capability proof

capabilities.cfbe_role: source admission, command integrity, provenance and leakage protection
capabilities.boundary: green source admission cannot promote provider or value state

v4_modules.vnext_change: CFBE semantic alias/readiness adapter with conflict, provenance and real-mission gates
